tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman go bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra ye/ 'gro skyob yid 'ong snying rje'i sku/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas/ /blo dman go bde bshad kyis nyon/ /gnas dben par stegs bu khebs ldan la maṇḍal gyi khar tshom bu dbus su che ba gcig dang / g.yas g.yon du chung ba re bkod/ de'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod lnga bshams/ bum pa dri bzang gi chu dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa stegs bu ji ltar 'os par bzhag dung chos rdor gzungs mi dgos/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ gis bsang / swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs so/ /stong pa'i ngang las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar rigs 'gre/ dril bsil/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhe thag pa nas skyabs 'gro ci nus su bya'o/ /bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

lan gcig de nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis jo bo thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i thugs kha'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ thal mo sbyar bas/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs/ /spyan gzigs gtso 'khor rnams la 'dud/ /ces pas phyag bya/ rang gi snying kha nas mchod yon me tog la sogs pa thogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo spros nas mchod par bsam la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai widye āḥhūm̐/ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod nas thal mo sbyar ste ngag tu/ dkon mchog gsum nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /bar lan gsum/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de yang dbus che ba/ tha ma chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba'i mdangs dang bcas pa/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ dbu skra phyed ral pa'i thor cog gyen du bsgrengs pa la dar dmar po'i cod paṇa yod pa/ dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba ni rlung gis bskyod pa lta bur dbun ne yod pa'o/ /phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba bsgrang zhing / g.yon gyi gnyis pas utpal la dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs khar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo 'bru drug ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na mu tig gi phreng ba bsgrang zhing / g.yon gyi gnyis pas utpal la 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas mdzes pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs khar gzigs pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi thugs khar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum pa mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arya ā wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/

badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod nas/ thal mo sbyar te ngag tu/ jo bo thugs rje chen po bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ mdun gyi lha gsum spyi bor byon nas so so la thim/ gtso bo'i thugs khar hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa la/ āoṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes pa chos skor du bskor nas yod pa la dmigs nas/ bzlas pa byas pas/ sgra thams cad sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang grags pas sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad sangs sangs dag par gyur/ ma ṇi padme ci nus bzla'o/ /mjug tu sngar bzhin mchod nas/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar/ /sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim/ mdun gyis tshom bu la dmigs te/ badzra yakṣas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gsum gyi dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po zhes pa nas gsum du gyur pa zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin/ dbus su thugs rje chen po zhes pa nas/ thugs khar gzigs pa zhes pa'i bar yang gong bzhin/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtso 'khor gsum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dza/ bdag bskyed bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ dam tshig pa la bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs/ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i thugs kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhi'i phyag tu bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga tha a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag ye shes kyi bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang / chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor gnyis la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ārya a wa lo ki shwa ra ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du pā dyaṃ nas/ shapta'i bar la mchod sngags bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra zhing / mthar dril gsil dharma ra ṇi/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran/ oṃ badzra yakṣas bsang ba ni/ nang du zhes pa'i bar mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin la/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ thal mo khang stong gi mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hī khā hī/ lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bzlas pa ji ltar rigs pa byas/ de nas bum pa/ badzra yakṣas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bhrūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yer ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha yi gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa nang bcud kyis gang ba bdag mdun gnyis ka'i phyag mdzub las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba bum nang du bab par gyur/

oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas/ 'di la lha bskyed pa ni/ bcu gcig zhal gyi bum sgrub dang 'dra bar 'dug de nas slob ma gos la khrus byas gral la 'khod pa na me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje can des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis las/ sngags kyi theg par rgyud sde bzhi bzhugs pa las 'dir bya rgyud kyi khongs su gtogs pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud sde rnams las 'byung ba ltar/ thugs rje dbang phyug gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba 'di nyid jo bo thugs rje chen pos grub chen rā hu la la gnang / de nas jo bo rje/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ rong pa phyag sor ba/ wa yu ba/ 'phags pa lce sgom pa/ de'i drung du dbon ston skyer sgang pas gsan te/ rim pa bzhin zhal gzigs byung ba'i lo rgyus ni dbon ston chen pos lo lnga bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ 'phags pa thugs rje re chung na da thug zhal mi ston pa zhus pas/ ngas khyod rang gis bsgrubs pa'i gong nas bzung yod kyang / khyod rang la sgrib pa ma dag pa dang / mthong na bsam 'dug pa des da bar ma mthong ba yin gsungs pa sogs byung / de nas rjes sems dpa' chen po'i bar la brgyud pa thams cad la zhal gzigs pa rkyang byung / sems dpa' chen pos kun mkhyen rin po che la 'di gnang dus ma ṇi bye ba bdun sogs gsungs/ rjes la song ba dang byas na dung lhag pa song mod tshod yin gsungs/ kun mkhyen rin po ches rdo ring rin po che la 'di'i rjes gnang gnang dus/

sems dpa' chen po yan la zhal gzigs pa rkyang byung 'dug nga khyer kha chung bas zhal ma gzigs/ khyed skyes bu dam pa gcig 'dug pas bsgrub na zhal gzigs yong gsungs/ rdo ring rin po che la rdo ring rong du yang gtso 'khor gsum zhal gzigs/ rjes nas tsha mo rang du yang zhal gzigs pa sogs zhal gzigs kyi lo rgyus mang zhing kho bos thob pa'i brgyud pa skyer sgang pa'i lugs ltar na skyer sgang pa nas gnyen ston chos kyi shes rab/ sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ge shong ston tshul khrims 'bum/ nyang ston rgyan mtshan dpal bzang / rdo rje gzhon nu/ mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog ratna wārdha/ rje lha mchog seng ge buddha seng hā/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / ngag dbang mchog legs rdo rje/ mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/ byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / thugs rje'i dbang phyug ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ yang 'di'i brgyud pa sa lugs ltar na/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyan mtshan/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bsod nams skyabs gzungs kyi dpal/ dpal tshul ba/ shar chen ye rgyal/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / mus chen dkon rgyal/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje ratna wardha/ rje lha mchog pa/ buddha seng hā/ de nas mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang nas gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gi bar 'dra ba dang / nye brgyud ni thugs rje chen po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge ratna wardha man 'dra ba bcas brgyud pa rnam par dag pa de dag las 'ongs pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba zhu/

oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs tshom bu bdun ma tshig lhug gam/ yang na/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing sogs gang rigs/ tshig lhug ltar na/ zhu ba'i yon du zhes dang / de ltar maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir mdun gyi maṇḍal tshom bu mdun gyis spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum du bskyed pa la skyabs gnas thams cad kyis bskor ba'i drung khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrub pa'i slad du slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i lus la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar mdun bskyed bzhin la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdakar po zhes pa dang / dbus su khyed rang thugs rje chen po zhes pa tsam khyad par gzhan 'dra/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gtso 'khor gsum gyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/

a be sha ya āḥ lan kha yar brjod cing / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bo bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod la bum chu khyor bar sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs sgrub thabs bzhin/ des lus kyi sgrib pa dag nas sku'i byin rlabs zhugs te sku'i rjes gnang thob pa yin/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ni slob dpon spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i/ thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis kyi tshul du byung / zhal nas thon khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ lan gsum/ slob mas me tog 'thor zhing / bcom ldan bdag sogs bya/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i mgor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang / sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bcom ldan 'das gtso 'khor gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams la sib kyis thim nas sku gsung thugs dang / khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du 'dres par bsam la spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam pa zhog mdzod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas dam tshig bsrung snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /rjes gnang thob pa'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

zhes dang maṇḍal tshig lhug bcad gang rung gong bzhin la lhug pa ltar na/ thob pa'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi/ zhes sogs dang / de ltar maṇḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /des spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas/ /skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'dren par shog /ces brjod la slob ma rang gnas su btang / mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gong bzhin/ 'dod gsol bdag bskyed kyi mjug bzhin/ rdor sems yig brgya bzlas min skabs sbyar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun 'phags pas bzod par mdzod/ /oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badzra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /skyon gyis ma gos sogs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog /ces sogs ci shes bya'o/ /zhes spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang 'di la brgyud pa'i rnam grangs jo lugs/ sa lugs/ skyer sgang pa nas bzung zhal gzigs kyi brgyud pa sogs mi 'dra ba gsum tsam 'dug kyang ngo bo gcig pas 'dir bdag bskyed mus chen bsod nams chen po'i gsung rab sor bzhag dang / rjes gnang gi chings mkhan ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i bka' gdams pa lha bzhi'i gras kyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skabs su gsungs pa de sor bzhag pa ni chings rgyas pa'i lugs yin bzhin/

bsdu na bdag mdun lugs gsum gyi chings ldan gyis kyang don 'grub pas nag 'gros rnam gzhag cung zad dang bcas pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la 'brug chos rje kun dga' rgya mtsho zhes bya bas yi ge'i lam nas bskul ba bzhin sbyar// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa'i sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
